summary: Ground explicitly labelled CSI/MasterFormat sections as atomic cited values and keep them scoped to exact workflow identities and source findings.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Project answers already expose specification-section and exact evidence-locator context
An offline reproduction proved that component-number validation accepted a section recombined from two cited sections
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only explicitly labelled three-group, two-digit CSI/MasterFormat sections and immediate two-digit extensions are interpreted.
Unlabelled codes, other standards and arbitrary subsection formats remain ordinary text.
The guard does not determine applicability, contractual authority, precedence or whether every relevant file was parsed.
